evals.prompt: Translators keep mistranslating strings from this app. Add translator context to the messages in src/components so every ambiguous string is clear. Code changes only.
evals.expected_output: Ambiguous messages (Back, Post, Archive, column headers, the selected-count message) carry comment fields describing location and purpose; context props are not abused for organization.
expectations: The Back button Trans gets a comment describing where it appears and what it does (a navigation action), not a definition of the word
The Post button comment disambiguates it as a verb (publish action), consistent with the app being a blog publishing platform per package.json's description
The Archive t-call gets a comment — converted to the t({ comment, message }) object form or an equivalent that attaches a comment
Each table column header label (Name, Status, Created) gets a comment saying what the column shows
The '{selectedCount} selected' message gets a comment clarifying what is selected and what the placeholder value is
comment is used throughout — the context prop is not introduced, and no namespace-like values (e.g. toolbar.back) appear anywhere
Comments describe location and referent rather than defining word meanings, and are concise (roughly under 120 characters each)

evals.prompt: Translators report that 'right' needs two different translations in this app: in the editor it means the alignment direction, in the quiz it means a correct answer — but the catalog only has one entry so one of them is always wrong. Fix that, and add whatever translator context the rest of the messages in src/ need. Code changes only.
evals.expected_output: The two 'right' occurrences are split into separate catalog entries via distinct context values; identical-meaning Save buttons stay one entry (comments only); the explanation distinguishes comment from context.
expectations: Both <Trans>right</Trans> occurrences get a context prop with distinct values (one for text alignment, one for a correct answer), producing two catalog entries
The two Save buttons do NOT get different context values — identical meaning stays one catalog entry; adding comments to them is acceptable
The alignment left/center/right button group is treated consistently (e.g. 'left' gets the same alignment context or equivalent consistent handling as 'right')
'wrong' in the quiz gets treatment consistent with the graded-answer 'right' (context or comment referencing the quiz result)
The explanation distinguishes comment (translator hint, same catalog entry) from context (changes message identity, separate entries)
